Bronx Chiropractor - Dr. Ralph Napolitano has come to be known for his entertaining and informative chiropractic adjusting videos on YouTube, Instagram and TikTok.

He currently sees patients as The Bronx Chiropractor in The Bronx, NY. 

People have traveled hours to see him from New Jersey, Connecticut, Massachusetts, Pennsylvania and from states all over the United States.

He specializes in Y-Strap Adjustments in NYC that help reduce the pressure, tension and stress that has built up in your spine and nervous system due to repetitive stress motion in poor posture.

Dr. Ralph says, “How you sit, stand, lift, bend and sleep has a direct affect on your spine and nervous system and slowly breaks it down over time causing you pain, discomfort and poor health.”

His unique adjusting techniques put him in the top 1% of chiropractors in the world and help relieve the tension, stress and pressure on your spine and nervous system so you can move better, feel better and live better.
